items.context: Kya aap complaint escalate karna chahenge?
items.text: theek hai samajh gaya

items.context: Aapke according kya next step hoga?
items.text: haan ji bataye kya karna hai
mera complaint number 2345 abhi tak solve nahi hua hai
maine 15 March ko complaint register kiya tha par koi update nahi mila
meri call drop ho gayi thi to fir se connect kara dijiye
please mere issue ko jaldi escalate karo main bahut pareshaan hu
mera account number 9876 5432 1098 hai aur paise kat gaye
main do mahine se recharge kar raha hu par service nahi mil rahi
aap logon ka customer care response bahut hi slow ho raha hai
Kya aap mujhe mera complaint ID bata sakte hain?
Kya aap batayenge ki aapko kya problem ho rahi hai?
Kya main aapka registered mobile number confirm kar sakta hu?
Kya aapke paas koi reference number hai is complaint ka?
Kya aapke network me abhi koi fault chal raha hai?
mai connect nahi ho pa raha hu aap logon se

items.context: Aapne kitni baar help desk ko contact kiya hai?
items.text: maine already 3 baar call kiya aur solution nahi mila

items.context: Kya aap apne internet problem ke baare mein bata sakte hain?
items.text: meri connection speed bahut slow hai aur baar baar disconnect hota hai

items.context: Kya aapko apne account ki recharge details chahiye?
items.text: kya aap mujhe mere last recharge ki details de sakte hain?

items.context: Kya aapne sim replace kara hai recently?
items.text: maine kal apna sim replacement liya tha lekin abhi tak kaam nahi kar raha
mai 5 din pehle complaint kiya tha ki mera net connection work nahi kar raha lekin abhi tak koi update nahi aaya
mere paas prepaid recharge paisa kat raha hai par service activate nahi ho raha mera account number 1234 5678 9101 hai
please mera issue escalate kijiye kyunki mujhe business calls ke liye acchi connection chahiye aur aapke service me kaafi problem hai
maine apni line ka billing issue 10 March ko report kiya tha aaj tak bill wapas nahi mila aur payment bhi nahi deduct hua
mere ghar me network coverage bahut weak hai aur mai customer care ko iske liye report kar chuka hu par abhi tak kuch problem solve nahi hui
maine apni complaint ko leke kai baar phone kiya but har baar alag alag baat hoti hai koi proper solution nahi mil raha hai
mere phone number 987 654 3210 ka sim activate karwana hai lekin activation me 3 din se delay ho raha hai ab toh mujhe bahut problem ho rahi hai

items.context: Aapko kis prakar ki madad ki zarurat hai?
items.text: maine apna account deactivate karne ko kaha tha par aapka staff time pe response nahi kar raha hai

items.context: Aapka complaint escalate hua hai ya nahi?
items.text: kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki mera complaint status kya hai mujhe 2 din pehle escalate kar diya tha

items.context: Complaint number provide karenge taaki hum check kar saken?
items.text: maine apne complaint reference number 5678 1234 ko call center par dhohraya hai lekin koi clear solution nahi de raha

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: escalate_complaint - is unhappy that an earlier complaint was not solved and wants escalation
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
